Lina (partnerships): FYI 1: KeyBridge Systems wants a joint marketplace launch + co-blog. Needs: SAML SSO, SCIM, KMIP/KMS wrap, and a Redwood secrets connector. Target go-live week: June 21. Short sync? :calendar:
Omar (product): I can. We should pick a single demo flow (console + REST wrap).
Nisha (security): Need FIPS 140-3 cert, attestation, and assurance that private keys never leave HSM (wrapped-only).
KeyBridge Rep: We have FIPS 140-3 and attestation PDF. KMIP endpoint: kmip.keybridge.example.com:5696. REST wrap: https://api.keybridge.example.com/kms/v1/wrap. Support RSA-OAEP-256 and AES-KW.
Kunal (eng): Can you provide a sample KMIP or REST wrap/unwrap exchange and a short-lived test tenant for staging?
KeyBridge Rep: Yes1: will provision staging tenant and upload creds. Timeline: staging by Jun 7, QA Jun 10-14, freeze Jun 17.
DevX (devex): SCIM base URL? Any custom attrs? We need test users for automated provisioning.
KeyBridge Rep: SCIM: https://scim.keybridge.example.com/v2. Custom attr: x:hardware_id for HSM mapping.
Omar (product): Action items: 1) attestation + certs (KeyBridge), 2) staging creds + SCIM sandbox (KeyBridge), 3) SCIM mapping sample (Kunal/DevX), 4) MOU + embargo (LegalBot), 5) demo script + webinar (Omar/Lina).
Kunal (eng): SCIM draft we plan to test:
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"},
  "active": true,
  "externalId": "emp-1234",
  "x:hardware_id": "hb-9a8b7c",
  "groups": ["platform-team"]
}
```
Nisha (security): Include MOU clause: no unwrapped key export; partner must allow audit of wrap ops in staging.
KeyBridge Rep: Agreed on wrapped-only and audit access for test tenant.
LegalBot: Draft MOU will be uploaded today. Recommend 72-hour embargo after asset sign-off.
DevX (devex): Created calendar hold: Wed Jun 8 9:30am PT for a 30m sync. calendar-bot: meeting scheduled.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: partnerships x KeyBridge onboarding 1: Wed Jun 8, 9:30am PT. Zoom link in invite.
Lina (partnerships): Nice. Before the sync: KeyBridge upload attestation + creds; LegalBot drop MOU; DevX prep SCIM test set and demo runbook. We'll convert action items to tasks after the call. :white_check_mark:
